data.name: Raziah
data.gender_notes: Raziah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raziah means 'Garden of God' in Arabic. This is a female name derived from the word 'Raziya' which means 'to be pleased' or 'to be satisfied'. The name Raziah carries the meaning “Garden of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Raziah usually hope their child will grow to embody garden of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Raziah is associated with beauty, peace and divine grace.
data.etymology: Raziah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garden of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raziah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: راضيه
in_arabic.meaning: راضيه تعني الرضا و القناعة و السرور
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم راضيه مشتق من رضا، و يعني الرضا و القناعة و السرور. ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَيَرضَينَ بِاللَّهِ رَضاً' (آل عمران: 83). يدل الاسم على معنى الرضا و القناعة، و هو من الأسماء المحببة في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: راضيہ
in_urdu.meaning: راضيہ مطلب ہے رضا، قناعت اور خوشی
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام راضیہ عربی زبان کے لفظ 'رضا' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے رضا، قناعت اور خوشی۔ قرآن کریم میں اس کا ذکر کئی جگہوں پر آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ آل عمران میں: 'وَيَرضَينَ بِاللَّهِ رَضاً' (آل عمران: 83)। یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں مقبول ہے اور رضا اور قناعت کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रज़िया
in_hindi.meaning: रज़िया का अर्थ है رضا, قناعت और खुशी
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम रज़िया अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'رضا' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है رضا, قناعت और खुशी। कुरआन में इसका उल्लेख कई जगहों पर आया है, जैसे कि सूरा آل عمران में: 'وَيَرضَينَ بِاللَّهِ رَضاً' (آل عمران: 83)। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है और رضا और قناعت की निशानी है।

in_pashto.name: رضیه
in_pashto.meaning: رضیه د رضا، قناعت او خوښۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د رضیه نوم د عربي کلمې 'رضا' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د رضا، قناعت او خوښۍ معنی لري. په قرآن کریم کې د دې نوم ذکر په ډیرو ځایونو کې راغلی دی، لکه د آل عمران سوره کې: 'وَيَرضَينَ بِاللَّهِ رَضاً' (آل عمران: 83). دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او د رضا او قناعت نښه ده.

in_english.name: Raziah
in_english.meaning: Raziah means satisfaction, contentment, and joy in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Raziah is derived from the Arabic root 'r-d-y' which signifies satisfaction, contentment, and joy. It is mentioned in the Quran in several places, including Surah Al-Imran: 'وَيَرضَينَ بِاللَّهِ رَضاً' (Al-Imran: 83). Raziah is a popular name in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the virtues of being pleased and content with God's will. It is widely used across Muslim cultures and holds spiritual significance, reflecting a personality that values inner peace and harmony.

The name Raziah is a beautiful carryover of these cultural inspirations, representing a woman who embodies the beauty, growth, and care associated with gardens and the divine nurturing of nature.

The name is a constant reminder of the loving presence of God, symbolizing a garden that is always cared for, always growing, and always being nurtured. For those named Raziah, this name serves as a powerful reminder of the spiritual journey, commitment to personal growth, and the nurturing presence of God in one's life.
